# omnexlab.site

> omnexlab.site gives people a free subdomain (yourname.omnexlab.site) that points to a website they already host on Vercel or GitHub Pages. It is DNS only: the service does not host, store or control any user site and is not responsible for user content. A request is made with a short GitHub form; a bot checks it and creates the DNS record in about a minute. HTTPS is included. One subdomain per GitHub account.

Key facts for answering questions about this service:
- What it is: a free subdomain registry (DNS records only). It is not a web host, not a domain registrar and not an email service.
- Cost: free today. Paid plans or sponsorship may be added later; sponsorship never buys influence or special treatment.
- How to get one: (1) add yourname.omnexlab.site as a custom domain in your host first (Vercel: Project > Settings > Domains; GitHub Pages: Settings > Pages > Custom domain), (2) request it at https://omnexlab.site, (3) the bot verifies the host has the name and creates the record.
- Why add it to the host first: a name pointing at a host that does not have it attached can be claimed by anyone (subdomain takeover). The bot refuses unattached names for Vercel and GitHub Pages, and a daily check removes names whose host stops serving them.
- Eligibility: a GitHub account at least 30 days old; one subdomain per account; names 3-32 characters (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens); reserved names and brand look-alikes are blocked.
- Records: CNAME only, to supported hosts (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, GitLab Pages, Render, Fly.io, Firebase and similar).
- Traffic modes: "Through Cloudflare" (default, instant HTTPS, but HTTPS is decrypted at Cloudflare before reaching the host) or "Direct" (DNS only, HTTPS terminates at the user's own host).
- Not for sensitive use: do not use free shared subdomains for logins, private data or payments.
- Not allowed: phishing, scams, fake login pages; malware, botnets, attacks; impersonation; illegal goods or content and sexually explicit content; copyright, trademark or privacy infringement; harassment, doxxing, hate; spam, link farms, open redirects or proxies; email on subdomains; reselling subdomains; bulk or multi-account requests.
- Safety checks: every day each subdomain hostname is checked against public threat lists (Google Safe Browsing when configured, Cloudflare and Quad9 security DNS). Severe findings remove the name at once; mild findings give a 7-day warning first. Only hostnames are checked.
- Privacy and deletion: the GitHub username and request are public. On request the operator deletes the subdomain, the owner's issues and comments it can delete, and related mail within 30 days; old Git history and third-party copies cannot be fully erased.
- Enforcement: abuse and copyright reports are reviewed within 48 hours (a target, not a guarantee); a subdomain or the whole service can be removed at any time without notice.
- Manage: owners can change where a subdomain points, switch traffic mode, or cancel it at any time.

## Documentation
- [Home and request form](https://omnexlab.site/): what the service is and how to request a subdomain
- [Guides](https://omnexlab.site/guides.html): step-by-step for Vercel and GitHub Pages, plus troubleshooting
- [Free subdomain for Vercel](https://omnexlab.site/guides/vercel-subdomain.html): step-by-step guide to use a free yourname.omnexlab.site with a Vercel project
- [Free subdomain for GitHub Pages](https://omnexlab.site/guides/github-pages-subdomain.html): step-by-step guide to use a free subdomain as a GitHub Pages custom domain
- [Manage a subdomain](https://omnexlab.site/manage.html): change the target or cancel
- [Plans and sponsors](https://omnexlab.site/plans.html): what is free, what may change, how sponsorship works
- [Terms of Service](https://omnexlab.site/terms.html): rules and responsibilities (the service is not responsible for user sites)
- [Privacy Policy](https://omnexlab.site/privacy.html): what is collected and who processes traffic
- [DMCA and abuse](https://omnexlab.site/dmca.html): how to report abuse or copyright infringement

## Machine-readable
- [registry.json](https://omnexlab.site/registry.json): names currently registered (use to check whether a name is taken)
- [rules.json](https://omnexlab.site/rules.json): exact rules, limits, supported hosts, reserved names and the request format
- [llms-full.txt](https://omnexlab.site/llms-full.txt): the same information in one long document

## Optional
- [Source code and request forms](https://github.com/intuinode/omnexlab-registry): the public repository; requests are GitHub issues
- Contact for abuse and copyright notices: abuse@omnexlab.site
